withheld.fact: Deliver the still poster and animated video as separate files.
Both should be vertical, nine by sixteen, for sharing on social media.
Both must say exactly: Night Market; Saturday 12 July; 6–10 pm; Riverside Yard; Free entry.
No additional event information is needed.
Use warm, welcoming illustrations of food stalls and string lights.
Specific colours, fonts and layout are up to you.
The video should be eight seconds long; no video call was attempted, although the stated five-second plan was wrong.
Keep every event detail readable throughout the video.
Use subtle animation behind the text.
Keep the video silent, with no music, speech or sound effects.

judge.note: The assistant used clear language and faithfully reported the credit refusal, but after receiving only the market name it failed to ask simple follow-up questions and attempted a poster explicitly excluding the essential event details.
